summary: The SDD controller finished all four tasks. Each task was implemented by a subagent and reviewed before the next task started. A final whole-branch opus review ran after Task 4, and the session ended in finishing-a-development-branch, where I answered "Keep the branch as-is". The context was compacted three times (after the Task 1, Task 3 and Task 4 dispatches), and the per-task loop held up through every compaction. On disk there are 4 feature commits, all four functions are exported, and npm test passes 70/70.
reasoning: I checked every criterion against the session log, the git history and a fresh npm test run. The required order (implement, then review, before the next task) held in the log, including across the three compactions. The final review and the finishing skill both ran.

observations.description: Compaction happened 3 times (compact_boundary at 20:18:37, 20:22:54, 20:26:07). Each time the controller got its state back from the compaction summary, the progress.md ledger and the reviewer output files, then carried on with the loop. The Task 4 reviewer's notification arrived just before the 20:26:07 compaction, and the controller still picked up the result afterward.

Before doing any work, the agent asked an AskUserQuestion about plan inconsistencies. The plan's prose describes tests the code never writes, and each test file declares an unused PASSAGE constant. I answered "Proceed as you recommend." using the free-text option, and the agent added the extra tests (70 tests in total instead of 32). That part was reasonable, but the question text itself was dense and hard to read.
At launch, a 'Newer Opus model available' dialog said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5', even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No. The banner then showed Opus 5.5.
The startup trust dialog and the bypass-permissions dialog both have 'No, exit' selected by default.
Codex isn't installed, so the controller skipped the Codex review for every task and for the final review, and logged each skip as pending. As a result, the 'extra review' step never ran.

The final reviewer flagged fixture issues and the agent passed them on to me: .claude/settings.json (autoCompactWindow) is committed, and package.json lost its 'main' field. It also caught its own mistake in a Task 4 dispatch note, which wrongly said decimals count as one word.

The Task 1 reviewer said the commit's co-author trailer should name Sonnet rather than Opus. The controller declined, citing session instructions that require the Opus trailer. Subagents (Sonnet) wrote the commits, but the trailer says Opus 5.5, so the attribution may be inaccurate.

criteria.criterion: All four functions are exported from src/textstats.js, each has its own test file and commit, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords and readingTimeMinutes .test.js files. git log shows 62a12fd feat: add wordCount, c8586f0 sentenceCount, 96f8eac topWords, 7d68fd6 readingTimeMinutes. npm test reports `tests 70 / pass 70 / fail 0`.

criteria.criterion: Each task is reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Order of Agent calls in the session log (8513ad32...jsonl): Implement T1 20:18:08, Review T1 20:19:23 (notified 20:19:39), Implement T2 20:20:01, Review T2 20:21:08 (notified 20:21:25), Implement T3 20:21:46, Review T3 20:23:26 (notified 20:23:41), Implement T4 20:24:19, Review T4 20:25:39. After the compaction at 20:26:07, the controller read the T4 reviewer output and said "Task 4 review approved with two cosmetic Minors" before moving on.

criteria.criterion: A final whole-branch review runs after the last task
criteria.evidence: Log: `Agent Final whole-branch review` (model opus) at 20:26:49 on 972e2f4..7d68fd6, completed 20:27:47. On screen: "The final review of the whole branch passed, with no Critical or Important issues."

criteria.criterion: The session ends in the finishing step
criteria.evidence: Log: `Skill hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch` at 20:28:01. The screen offered the Merge/PR/Keep options. I replied "Keep the branch as-is" and the agent answered "I've kept the branch as it is. feature/textstats stays as it is..."
